segments.text:
Verſ. 19.
And it ſhall bee eaſie to number the rest of the trees of his forreſt: for a little child ſhall tell them.

THe Hebrew phraſe ſhewes that there ſhall be a very ſmall number left; and thus hee onely confirms the former ſentence, to wit,
that there ſhal be ſuch a waſte after the Lord ſhall haue brought the Aſſyrians downe, that the reſidue ſhall be eaſilie told. And yet he goes on further in ſaying, there ſhall be ſo few, that a little child ſhall bee able to tell all that remaine: for we know that little children haue much adoe to count to three or foure. Thus then the kingdome of the Aſſyrians, which in times paſt appeared as a great forreſt, the trees thereof being cut downe and ouerthrowne, ſhall become like to a ſmall number of trees ſcattered a great way off one from another.
